batch: Batch 05 — Character States & Finishing Animations (Final Batch)

animations.gameplay_purpose: Round/match win animation showcasing Jatin's confident, stylish, self-satisfied personality.
animations.starting_and_ending_pose_notes: F1 exits fighting stance; F2 straightens up relaxed; F3 adjusts glasses stylishly; F4 proud satisfied smirk; F5 folds arms smoothly; F6 holds stable confident arms-crossed victory pose.
F1 realizes loss; F2 confidence fades and guard drops; F3 shoulders slump in frustration; F4 hand raises to forehead reacting; F5 holds stable disappointed/irritated defeated pose.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Arcade fighting-game knockout collapse when HP reaches zero.
animations.starting_and_ending_pose_notes: F1 strong hit jolt; F2 upper body recoils; F3 balance fails; F4 knees buckle downward; F5 collapses onto back (head left, feet right); F6 holds stable flat knocked-out pose (head left, feet right, zero blood/gore).

animations.gameplay_purpose: In-match personality taunt showcasing Jatin's modern cash-minded arrogance using a fictional green paper banknote.
animations.starting_and_ending_pose_notes: F1 confident taunt start; F2 reaches toward pocket; F3 pulls out fictional green paper banknote; F4 displays/flicks bill arrogantly; F5 smirks and gestures dismissively toward opponent; F6 returns smoothly to Batch 1 Standing Guard.
